scope: Theorem 1.3 of the manuscript “A conditional abelianity theorem for special fourfold pairs with a half-weight divisor” (preprints/A-conditional-abelianity-theorem-for-special-fourfold-pairs-with-a-half-weight-divisor-October-5-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 057 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d017fae040e20002), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Assumption 1.2. Let X be a connected smooth projective complex fourfold and let D ⊂ X be a nonempty smooth connected reduced divisor. If 2 q (X, D) is special, then (1.3) G = π1(X \ D, x) . ⟨⟨γ2 ⟩⟩ contains an abelian subgroup of finite index. Here γ is a positively oriented meridian about D, transported to x ∈ X \ D.
